Evidence Requested: Export of privileged users, assigned roles and approval records
Assessment Note: Evidence must be dated, complete and reconciled to the account inventory.

Evidence Requested: MFA policy and technical configuration demonstrating privileged-account coverage
Assessment Note: A policy alone does not prove technical enforcement.

Evidence Requested: Current network architecture and sampled firewall/security-group rules
Assessment Note: Check for unnecessary paths between trust zones and document exceptions.

Evidence Requested: Recent vulnerability scan, remediation tracker and approved SLA
Assessment Note: Check scan coverage, aging, exceptions and overdue critical findings.

Evidence Requested: Log source inventory, retention settings and sample alert/review records
Assessment Note: Check coverage of critical systems, integrity, access and retention.

Evidence Requested: Backup configuration and most recent restoration-test evidence
Assessment Note: Record actual restoration results against approved recovery objectives.

Evidence Requested: Critical vendor inventory, risk assessments, assurance evidence and relevant contract clauses
Assessment Note: Confirm review date, scope, exceptions and owner.

Evidence Requested: CI/CD security checks, code-review evidence and exception approvals
Assessment Note: Check whether checks run consistently and failed gates can be bypassed.

Evidence Requested: Secret-scanning results, managed-secret configuration and rotation records
Assessment Note: Do not include live credentials or secret values in portfolio evidence.

Evidence Requested: Incident-response plan, exercise results and tracked lessons learned
Assessment Note: Confirm scenarios, participants, decisions and action closure.

Evidence Requested: Approved classification standard and sample data-handling decisions
Assessment Note: Use synthetic samples only in public portfolio materials.

Evidence Requested: Approved cloud baseline, configuration-drift report and change records
Assessment Note: Confirm drift findings are triaged and exceptions approved.
